name: construction.public-story
description: Advisory screening of authentic public construction problem stories. Separates corpus relevance from purchase intent; uncalibrated, not authorization or demand prevalence.

content_class.instructions: Classify supplied actual public title and full body. Select first_person_problem_or_request only for an author describing concrete construction execution, equipment use, maintenance, rental, project planning friction or a specific question/request about it. Sellers, jobs and third-party generic news cannot count as problem stories. Identity is unverified and commercial intent is a separate question.

criteria.first_person_problem_or_request: Concrete construction-use problem, lived experience or specific request/question
criteria.seller_promotion: Vendor/dealer offer, sales CTA, affiliate pitch or self-promotion
criteria.job_ad_or_career: Recruitment, job seeking or generic career advice
criteria.general_context: News, general assertion or third-party industry commentary without a concrete author's problem
criteria.off_topic: Outside construction execution and associated machine tasks
criteria.insufficient: Actual source text missing, too sparse or contradictory

construction_pain_relevance.instructions: The supplied text states a concrete heavy/compact construction equipment use, service, repair, attachment, rental or acquisition friction, OR a concrete water/road/utility/power/data-center civil execution constraint that connects to machine work, scheduling, mobilization, earthworks or inspection. A specific feature/function or planning-to-machine-task problem qualifies. Agricultural-only, general AI news, office work, houses without relevant execution detail, generic market commentary and assumed inferred machine needs fail. Judge supplied words only; do not infer verified identity, representativeness or purchase intent.

quote_fit.instructions: The submitted quote is an exact contiguous substring of the supplied title or full body, with at most 12 words; quote_field identifies its provenance. Full actual body and a canonical source link are supplied. The excerpt expresses the stated problem without inventing personal identity, demand frequency, outcome or current commercial terms. Missing/normalized/paraphrased quotes fail.

rules.reason: Construction execution problem not sufficiently explicit

notes.count_rule: Count only first_person_problem_or_request with choice confidence >=0.90, both noul scores >=0.90 AND deterministic full-body, canonical-link, exact quote and unique-root gates. All other rows remain held/rejected candidates. Purchase intent and author business identity remain separately unknown unless supported.
notes.separation: Do not replace deere.social-demand. Relevant-story count and strict commercial-demand PASS count are separate. No prevalence inference from a nonrepresentative convenience sample.
